contentPattern.structure: background looping video + eyebrow + heading + paragraph + overlaid statistics bar (3 figure/label pairs) + CTA link

suitableFor: top-of-page dark hero banners with a looping background video
brand banners that overlay a small statistics / KPI strip on the hero
About / Our Company style intros combining a headline with headline figures
notSuitableFor: light hero banners with a white content card (use hero-video)
simple heroes without an overlaid stats strip
